subject: Board-ready: C-suite slate and Q3 headcount ask
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, talent@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Board-ready: C-suite slate and Q3 headcount ask

Team —

Quick summary up front: I am requesting board-ready approval to open and commit offers for two senior roles in Q3 (Tranche 1): VP Engineering (platform) and Head of Product (AI infra). We are proposing the following:

- Tranche 1 hires (immediate recruiting + offers): VP Engineering, Head of Product
- Tranche 2 (defer to Q4, contingent on pipeline): CRO role (external candidate pool via Landing Hire)

Rationale: both Tranche 1 roles are blocking work for our Dedicated/Private roadmap that the largest prospects are asking for (throughput SLAs, VPC integrations). Delaying these buys risks stalling three active mid-market deals.

Comp bands & ask (see attached Comp_Bands_2027.xlsx and Q3_HC_Request.xlsx):
- VP Engineering (Level: Exec-2): base $320k–370k, target OTE (base + bonus) ~ $380k–430k, equity grant range 0.12%–0.20% depending on experience.
- Head of Product (Level: Exec-2): base $290k–340k, target OTE ~ $350k–400k, equity grant 0.10%–0.16%.

Requested approvals:
1) Headcount and budget for Tranche 1 (2 roles) — hiring managers to extend offers up to the stated ranges.
2) Authority for recruiting to negotiate signing bonuses up to $40k for VP Eng and $25k for Head of Product (one-time, capped).
3) Ask that offers be marked "board-ready" for signatures and that HR route final offers to Finance for payroll/code assignment.

Timeline: recruiting can extend verbal offers this week; we need final OK by EOD Monday 5/31 to hit candidate timelines.

Attachments (stubs): [Attachment: Q3_HC_Request.xlsx (124KB)], [Attachment: Comp_Bands_2027.xlsx (96KB)], [Attachment: Offer_Template_EXEC.pdf (48KB)]

If you want a one-pager for the board, I can produce a trimmed slate with justification and expected ARR impact. Requesting explicit +1 / -1 / hold from each of you.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Head of Talent & Growth Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, talent@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Board-ready: C-suite slate and Q3 headcount ask

Connor —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few quick items before I can give a full +1:  

1) Signing bonus caps: please cap sign-on for the VP Eng at $30k unless there is a counteroffer that materially changes time-to-fill. We should avoid setting a precedent where we exceed banded sign-ons for all Exec-2 roles.
2) Equity vs. cash mix: can you add the proposed full dilution impact across the three hires across FY27? We should show options burned and projected refresh needs.
3) Option pool: if we go to the top of the band for VP Eng, confirm we have the runway / pool approvals (I think we do but want explicit numbers).
4) Tranche split: I prefer we decouple CRO approval to Q4 unless Marcus pushes for revenue-critical timing.

On the Head of Product band: please confirm market comps from Landing Hire (Karen) — I don't want us to be more than two deciles above market for these roles.

I am tentatively +1 on the Head of Product and conditionally +1 on VP Eng subject to (a) reducing cap on one-time sign-on and (b) finance's confirmation on option pool.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Chief People Officer
Redwood Inference

Quick note from my side —

I support opening Tranche 1 and authorizing recruiting to move to offers with the following conditions:
- Finance must confirm the option pool usage and impact on FY28 refresh by Monday EOD. If pool consumption exceeds 0.45% of outstanding, we need CFO sign-off for additional grants.
- Cap the VP Eng sign-on at $35k (split cash/equity bridge possible), which is a compromise between Connor's ask and Laura's cap.
- Offers should include a 90-day business milestone clause for executive incentives (simple, non-punitive) tied to product milestones.

If those conditions are acceptable I will mark this as "authorized to recruit/offer". Please loop in Finance (Marcos?) for final budget code.

—Aditya

All —

From a revenue / GTM standpoint I am supportive of moving VP Eng and Head of Product into Tranche 1. These hires are directly tied to at-risk pipeline (2 deals > $800k ARR each if we land the integrations). Finance (me) can commit the budget for Tranche 1 from the Q3 hiring bucket. Notes:

- Approved: Headcount and budget for the two Tranche 1 roles. Recruiting may issue offers up to the bands listed (with the sign-on caps described by Aditya).
- Equity: ok within stated ranges; if a candidate requests >0.20% for VP Eng we need to escalate to the CEO for special approval.
- CRO timing: I agree with deferring CRO to Q4 unless an exceptional candidate surfaces that materially accelerates deals.

Connor — please proceed to verbal offers today. Karen (Landing Hire) — happy to have your team coordinate timelines with recruiting.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
SVP, Revenue Operations (Acting Finance Lead for Hire Approvals)
